categories.name: Missed a hanging piece
categories.coaching_desc: You played a quiet move while your opponent had an undefended piece sitting there for free — just take it!
categories.mechanism_signature: bw≥0.7, oh≤0.5, chk≤0.25 — best move wins clear material via simple capture, player didn't leave own piece hanging, best move is not a check

categories.name: Missed a winning check or fork
categories.coaching_desc: You had a devastating check — a fork, skewer, or forcing blow — that wins major material, but you played something else.
categories.mechanism_signature: bw≥0.7, oh≤0.5, chk≥0.7 — best move is a check that wins material, player's move didn't hang own piece badly

categories.name: Missed checkmate
categories.coaching_desc: You had forced checkmate available and played something else entirely — always scan for mate before anything else!
categories.mechanism_signature: bw≥0.9, oh≤0.5, chk≥0.9 — best move delivers immediate or forced short mate, player often played a quiet or greedy move

categories.name: Hung own piece (unforced)
categories.coaching_desc: You left your own piece completely undefended — before moving, always ask 'is my piece safe on this square?'
categories.mechanism_signature: bw≤0.4, oh≥0.7, chk≤0.2 — player's move left own piece en prise, no dramatically better capture was available (error is purely the hang)

categories.name: Greedy capture backfires
categories.coaching_desc: You grabbed material but your capturing piece (or another piece) ended up hanging — check what happens AFTER you take!
categories.mechanism_signature: bw≥0.3, oh≥0.8, chk≤0.3 — player's capture left own piece en prise; a calmer move would have been better

categories.name: Pointless check leaves piece hanging
categories.coaching_desc: You gave a tempting check but after the king moved, your piece was left hanging — checks aren't free if they cost material!
categories.mechanism_signature: bw≥0.3, oh≥0.6, chk≤0.15 — player gave check (per label), but best move was NOT a check; player's checking piece or another piece left hanging

categories.name: Chose capture over stronger check
categories.coaching_desc: You took a piece but missed a much stronger check that would have won even more — checks before captures!
categories.mechanism_signature: bw≥0.7, oh moderate(0.3–0.8), chk≥0.6 — best move was a check, player instead captured (sometimes leaving pieces hanging)

categories.name: Missed quiet winning move (trap or threat)
categories.coaching_desc: You missed a subtle non-forcing move — a pawn advance, piece reposition, or trap — that would have won material through threats.
categories.mechanism_signature: bw≥0.8, oh≤0.5, chk≤0.15 — best move wins material but is NOT a capture or check; it creates an unavoidable threat or trap

categories.name: Quiet move both misses tactic and hangs piece
categories.coaching_desc: You played a passive move that was doubly wrong — you ignored a winning capture AND left your own piece undefended.
categories.mechanism_signature: bw≥0.5, oh≥0.5, chk≤0.35 — significant material was available (bw) AND player's quiet move hung own material (oh); a compounding blunder

categories.name: Endgame king and pawn technique error
categories.coaching_desc: You mishandled a pure endgame — wrong king direction, premature pawn push, or lost opposition that threw away the result.
categories.mechanism_signature: bw≤0.4, oh≤0.35, chk≤0.15 — no huge material swing or piece hanging; the error is strategic/technical mispositioning in endgames

categories.name: Ignored critical tension or necessary exchange
categories.coaching_desc: You ignored a critical capture or exchange that the position demanded — resolve tension before it costs you!
categories.mechanism_signature: bw≤0.35, oh 0.3–0.7, chk≤0.2 — best move is a necessary even exchange (SEE≈0) or pawn tension resolution, player played elsewhere leaving pieces vulnerable

categories.name: Passive play in active position
categories.coaching_desc: You played a slow or routine move when the position demanded concrete action — develop a sense of urgency!
categories.mechanism_signature: bw 0.2–0.7, oh≤0.4, chk≤0.3 — moderate material available, player didn't hang anything catastrophically, just played too slowly

categories.name: Unsound sacrifice or premature attack
categories.coaching_desc: You launched an attack or sacrifice without sufficient calculation — the combination doesn't work and you just lose material.
categories.mechanism_signature: bw 0.2–0.7, oh≥0.9, chk≤0.2 — player's 'sacrifice' leaves piece hanging with no compensation; better quiet alternatives existed

categories.name: Missed pawn promotion
categories.coaching_desc: You had a pawn ready to queen and didn't promote it — always check if you can make a new queen!
categories.mechanism_signature: bw 0.5–0.9, oh 0.15–0.5, chk 0.0–0.5 — best move is promotion (massive material gain), player played a temporizing move instead
